name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the continuation is connected to the context and the preceding conversation. The response should be logically and contextually related to the topic at hand.
scale: Binary (0 or 1) or a continuous scale (e.g., 0-1)

name: Fluency
description: Measures the grammatical correctness and readability of the continuation. The response should be free from grammatical errors and easy to read and understand.
scale: Binary (0 or 1) or a continuous scale (e.g., 0-1)

name: Coherence
description: Measures the logical flow and coherence of the continuation. The response should be well-connected and structured, with clear and consistent ideas.
scale: Binary (0 or 1) or a continuous scale (e.g., 0-1)

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and uniqueness of the continuation. The response should be engaging and interesting, avoiding clichés and generic statements.

name: Engagement
description: Measures the ability of the continuation to spark interest and maintain the conversation. The response should encourage further dialogue and avoid abrupt ends or off-topic remarks.
